title: A one-variable polynomial ring over a field is regular
statement: Let $k$ be a field. The polynomial ring $k[t]$ is a regular ring (Noetherian and with every localization at a prime a regular local ring) [def-weil-regular-scheme].

source.place: Proposition Tag 00OQ, polynomial rings over regular rings are regular, specialized to one variable over a field
